verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no first-party export, takeout, or bulk-download feature for leaving SharePoint with all data in open formats. The only related evidence is the REST and Graph APIs, which allow file and list CRUD and return JSON or Atom. These are developer building blocks from which a user could construct an export, not an export capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
